mathematical_contract.support_axes: For signed radial endpoint vectors R1 and R2 on an already-proved common nonzero circle, exact signs of cross(R1,R2) and dot(R1,R2) determine every closed-semicircle relation without angle evaluation.
mathematical_contract.collinear_axes: When cross(R1,R2)=0, dot(R1,R2) distinguishes equal and antipodal radial axes. Equal selected halves are exactly the cases where radial-axis agreement equals traversal agreement; the other cases are complementary halves with both antipodal endpoints and no positive-length overlap.
mathematical_contract.noncollinear_axes: When cross(R1,R2) is nonzero, its sign combined with each traversal sign identifies the one foreign endpoint strictly inside each selected half. Those two endpoints are the complete positive-length overlap boundaries and are ordered independently on both parameter domains.
mathematical_contract.parameter_map: Own endpoints map to exact zero or one. A foreign boundary is ordered through dot(R1,R2)/|R_i|^2 against the strictly monotone rational diameter coordinate (1-2u)/((1-u)^2+u^2), retaining one correlated selected-root witness rather than constructing a primitive element.
mathematical_contract.fast_path: Semicircles sharing the same retained frame allocation and equal or opposite signed radii resolve full overlap or complementary endpoints structurally; synthetic but algebraically equal frames deliberately fall through to exact correlated predicates.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT accepts only exact correlated signs and selected-root equality. APPROXIMATE_512 executes the same topology graph and may terminate only through the existing recorded 512-bit predicate boundary.
